title: Stowe, Okemo & Mount Snow Target Winter Opening Date of Nov. 21

**STOWE, VT (October 26, 2026)** **–** The countdown to winter is on.


**Stowe Mountain Resort, Okemo Mountain Resort, and Mount Snow** are targeting


**Saturday, November 21*** **** to begin the 2026/27 ski and ride season, marking the official start of winter


across the Green Mountains. Lock in for Opening


Day, and get your Epic Pass by November 15 before prices go up.


## **C elebrate The First Turns of the Season November 21 at:**


-


Stowe


–


This season marks


**90 years of skiing and riding on Vermont's highest peak** , celebrating a legacy that helped shape the sport in the East. From the resort's storied Ski & Ride School and long-standing Ski Patrol tradition to the legendary Front Four trails, Stowe's milestone season honors nine decades of mountain culture, innovation, and unforgettable winters.


-


Okemo


–


T


his season, Okemo


builds on its reputation for exceptional snow surfaces with a multi-million-dollar snowmaking


investment


.


U


p


grades completed this summer will increase snowmaking efficiency, expand snow production capacity, and position Okemo to take advantage of more snowmaking opportunities throughout the winter season.


-


Mount Snow


–


Vermont’s closest destination ski reso


rt to Boston and New York City, Mount Snow is known for keeping the energy high all season long. This winter, that energy comes with more local flavor.


The


**new Maple Syrup Flight at Iron Loft offers a true taste of Vermont,**


featuring locally sourced Golden, Amber, and Dark maple syrups paired with mini waffles or tater tots.


## **Ski & Ride School in the My Epic App Expands t o Vermont**


This winter, guests taking group lessons at Stowe, Okemo and Mount Snow will enjoy an enhanced learning experience through the expanded


[Ski & Ride School in My Epic app](https://www.epicpass.com/app/ski-and-ride-lessons.aspx) . Designed to make learning more seamless, connected and rewarding, the experience provides digital lesson check-in, real-time updates and photos throughout the day, and a personalized record of skill progression that follows guests across participating resorts.


For families, the feature offers added peace of mind with visibility into a child's day on the mountain. For skiers and riders of all ages, it serves as a digital passport of their learning journey, capturing instructor feedback, terrain milestones, achievement


badges and lesson history all in one place. Whether taking a first lesson at Mount Snow, building confidence at Okemo or advancing skills at Stowe, guests can track their progress and celebrate accomplishments throughout the season.


## **Epic Pass: Your Key to Ultimate Access to the East Coast’s Best**


Vermont’s legendary slopes are


calling, and[Epic Pass](https://www.epicpass.com/) is


your key to the Green Mountain State’s finest terrain. Prices increase after November 15, so lock in a Pass now and plan your winter road trip up VT Route 100.


-


With new savings for young adults, skiers and riders ages 13 to 30 can


[save 20% on an Epic Pass or Epic Local Pass](https://www.epicpass.com/pass-results/college.aspx) compared to standard pass pricing, making it easier than ever for the next generation to access world-class skiing and riding.


-


For regional adventurers, the


[Northeast Value Pass](https://www.epicpass.com/passes/northeast-value-pass.aspx?ef_id=CjwKCAjwko21BhAPEiwAwfaQCPAsggqd3e06ga1CsSkrCE8BVlaWXkvDwx1NHrmorXNNs8nbHditQxoCDFQQAvD_BwE:G:s&s_kwcid=AL!11600!3!700816452224!e!!g!!northeast%20value%20pass!21055825649!164970681528&CMPID=PPC&gad_source=1&gclid=CjwKCAjwko21BhAPEiwAwfaQCPAsggqd3e06ga1CsSkrCE8BVlaWXkvDwx1NHrmorXNNs8nbHditQxoCDFQQAvD_BwE) (


$704) delivers unbeatable value closer to home, with access to top resorts across the region including Stowe, Hunter, Mount Snow, and Okemo (with some restrictions).


-


The


[Epic Local Pass](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4492303-1&h=1914499726&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.epicpass.com%2Fpasses%2Fepic-local-pass.aspx&a=Epic+Local+Pass) ($


869) provides


unlimited, season-long access to 29 resorts including Stowe (excludes peak dates), Okemo, and Mount Snow, plus access to more destination resorts with some restrictions.


-


O


ccasional, non-committal skiers and riders favor[Epic 1-7 Day Passes](https://www.epicpass.com/passes/epic-day-pass.aspx?days=7) which provide up to 65% savings compared to lift ticket


window prices by purchasing ahead of the season. The Epic Day Pass allows guests access to world-class resorts starting at as low as


$79 per day for adults at Vermont and New York resorts. Just like a season Pass, it comes with Epic Mountain Rewards and offers flexibility, as guests can decide when and where to use the day Pass later, whether that's all at one mountain on consecutive days or split over a variety of resorts throughout the season.


Epic Passes


unlock more than just lift access;


Epic Pass Holders receive[exclusive savings](https://www.epicpass.com/benefits/epic-mountain-rewards.aspx) i


ncluding 20% off dining, lodging, group lessons, and equipment rentals with Epic Mountain Rewards.


###


*O


pening dates are subject to change, based on weather and conditions.
